summary.text: SpaceX IPO rumors are creating a feeding frenzy around space stocks, with SPCE bagholders from 2021 hoping Musk can deliver what Branson couldn't.
Memory and AI infrastructure plays are printing serious returns as traders pile into LEAPS on data center beneficiaries and enterprise software rotation themes.
Despite scattered bearish positions on crypto proxies, the overall energy feels decidedly risk-on with profit screenshots dominating the conversation flow.
